abstract.para: Install &rmt; while installing &productname; with &agama; by adding the rmt-server package to the installation profile.

topic.para: &rmt; is not available as a software pattern, and the &agama; Web interface only lets you select patterns. To install &rmt; during installation, add the rmt-server package to the software section of an &agama; installation profile:

The rmt-server package is available from the &productname; product repository, so no additional repository is required. If you install with the &agama; Web interface instead, install &rmt; after the installation as described in .
Immediately after the &productnameshort; installation, run zypper patch to get the latest &rmt; updates. &suse; continuously releases maintenance updates for &rmt;.
